title: Andaman Tour Package Guide: Best Deals, Islands & Activities
subtitle: Everything you need to know about planning an island vacation — Port Blair, Havelock, Neil Island, scuba diving, and inter-island catamaran transfers.
excerpt: Planning an island holiday is easy with an Andaman Tour Package combining beach resorts, ferry transfers, scuba diving, and historical sightseeing across Port Blair, Havelock, and Neil.

contentSections.heading: Why Choose an Andaman Tour Package?
contentSections.content: Planning an island holiday is easy with an Andaman Tour Package that combines hotels, sightseeing, transfers, and activities in one plan. Whether travelling with family, friends, or your partner, you can choose a package that fits your budget. Enjoy beautiful beaches, clear waters, peaceful islands, exciting activities, and a memorable vacation without the stress of detailed planning. Planning hotels, transportation, sightseeing, and inter-island ferry transfers independently can be confusing, especially if you are visiting Andaman for the first time.

contentSections.heading: Top Islands and Places to Visit in Andaman
contentSections.content: An ideal Andaman holiday combines historical discovery in Port Blair with tropical relaxation on outer islands.
bulletPoints: Port Blair — the starting point, home to historic Cellular Jail, the evening Light & Sound show, Corbyn's Cove Beach, and lively seafood markets.
Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep) — world-famous for Radhanagar Beach (Beach No. 7), clear turquoise waters, and vibrant scuba diving and snorkeling at Elephant Beach.
Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep) — a serene, quieter island renowned for its natural living coral bridge (Howrah Bridge), shallow-water swimming at Bharatpur Beach, and Laxmanpur sunset vistas.

contentSections.heading: Top Activities to Enjoy in Andaman
contentSections.content: Scuba diving is one of the most popular experiences in Andaman with certified instructors and thriving marine life. Snorkeling at Elephant Beach offers a simpler way to view colorful reefs. Travelers also enjoy sea walks, glass-bottom boat rides, and relaxing sunset strolls on powder-soft beaches.

contentSections.heading: What is Included in an Andaman Tour Package?
contentSections.content: A comprehensive package from Safar Trails covers beachfront resort stays, daily breakfast, airport transfers, luxury catamaran cruise tickets (Makruzz/Nautika), private AC cabs on each island, Cellular Jail entry passes, and dedicated on-ground coordinators at all ferry jetties.

contentSections.heading: Best Time to Visit & Money-Saving Tips
contentSections.content: October to May is the ideal travel season with calm seas and clear skies. To save money, book 60–90 days ahead to secure affordable flight fares to Port Blair, choose combo packages bundling ferry tickets and transfers, and travel during October or early March to avoid peak holiday hotel surcharges.
